tasks.task: Open the reporting and set the week
tasks.how: Frequency: Weekly (Mon).; In Sprinklr, go to Social Listening > Reporting > All Topics. Set the date range to the previous week, Monday to Sunday (the work is done on Monday).
tasks.check: Date range = previous Monday to Sunday.

tasks.how: Frequency: Weekly.; Open Brand Mention Ranking and sort mention evolution descending. Check the top 10 manually: keep brands with both high evolution and high mentions (e.g. above 500). A big brand below 500 can still be worth checking.
tasks.check: About 10 brands kept, with growth and volume coherent.

tasks.task: Review the conversation of each brand
tasks.how: Frequency: Weekly.; Click the brand, open Show Conversation Stream and scroll quickly to see what drives the conversation (campaign, launch, ambassador...). Then open Smart Insights and look at the hashtags section.
tasks.check: Driver of the spike identified for each brand; key hashtags noted exactly as written.

tasks.task: Find this week's product launches/new collaboration/new brand ambassador/new collection
tasks.how: Frequency: Weekly.; Search LinkedIn for product launches of that week only (not the previous month, already covered). Prioritise fragrance, makeup and skincare; haircare is low priority.
tasks.tools: LinkedIn, Instagram, AI assistants (e.g. ChatGPT, Gemini)
tasks.check: Each launch dated in the week; not already added in a previous report.

tasks.how: Frequency: Weekly.; In Sprinklr, open the Keyword List and search the brand. Find the right list for the launch (e.g. Product List - Skincare, Makeup, Fragrance, Body Mist, Specific Topic List). Check whether the product or hashtag is already there.

Frequency: Weekly.; Add the missing keywords. Specific product name: write it as is. Generic name: put the brand in front, written the same way as in the existing list (e.g. [brand] vs [competitor brand]). Copy hashtags exactly as in Smart Insights. Create a new list if the category does not exist yet. See sheet 'Keyword writing rules'.
tasks.check: Names match the list conventions; generic terms carry the brand; no duplicate.

tasks.how: Frequency: When needed.; Add low-relevance terms to Exclusion List - Resale & Discounts (Part 1 or 2: fakes, resale, affiliates, promos) and automated or bot messages to Exclusion - Bots.

tasks.task: Tag profiles in the Global Profile Lists
tasks.how: Frequency: Weekly.; Go through the profile pages (pages 1 to 15; pages 8 to 10 often hold more untagged accounts). Tag each relevant account in the right list: Beauty Group Content Owned, Brand Content (Owned), Press/Magazine/News Social Channels, Retailers Social Channels, Resellers/Affiliates/Deals, Exclusion List - Bots. If an account is already tagged, update it anyway (click Yes). For accounts with few followers, check the account is genuine.
tasks.check: Each tagged profile fits its list; low-follower accounts verified.

tasks.how: Frequency: Weekly.; Download the Brand Mention Ranking export for the week and match growth % and volume to each brand.
tasks.check: Volume is the weekly figure; growth matches the export.

tasks.how: Frequency: Weekly.; In the client Sprinklr Weekly document, fill one row per brand: date, brand, category ([client] / Competitors), growth %, volume, key findings (what the launch or campaign is), recommendation, keyword placement, keywords to add. Sort from highest to lowest growth.
tasks.check: All columns filled; rows sorted by growth descending.

tasks.how: Frequency: Weekly.; Check the whole report once more for errors in product names, brand names and grammar.
tasks.check: No spelling error in brand or product names.
